buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the

additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ITEM TO BE SUPPLIED STRICTLY AS PER THE SPECIFICATION ENCLOSED IN THE ATC ONLY, OTH ERWISE THE ITEM WILL BE REJECTED. 1)The materials supplied, should strictly adhere to the specification as mentioned below: Specification of Intel core i3 All in One Desktop Computer System Category Description/Specification Configuration Intel core i3 Processor Number Intel core i3-13100 Memory 16GB minimum of 3200 MHz, DDR5 RAM expandability up to 64 GB utilizing at least two physical DIMM Graphics Integrated (Graphic card Make & Model must declare) Discrete TPM 2.0 or higher Yes Storage capacity 512GB PCIe NVMe M.20 SSD minimum speed of 3000 M/Bs supp ort up to 1 TB PCIe M.2 NVMe SSD or more Connectivity Wi-Fi 6 (802.1 lax) + Bluetooth 5.3 Number of Ports 1 HDMI Port, 1 DP Port, 1-USB 3.1 Gen 1 Type C, 2-USB 3.1 Gen 1 TYPE A, Universal Audio Jack, 1-RJ-45(10/100/1000 Ethernet Po rt), 1-USB 3.1Gen 2 TYPE A, 2-USB 3.1 Gen2 TYPE A Mouse Wired Keyboard Wired, Standard

Operating system Windows 11 Professional Pre loaded(64 Bit) with genuine life tim e commercial/acadamic OEM digital activation Webcam 720p HD, camera with integrated dual array digital microphones Audio Integrated Audio controller with Internal speaker Security Advanced firmwave protection pre-integrated into the mother bo ard Screen size / Display certification Narrow bezel, 23.8” or higher FHD (1920x1080) Display. TCO 9.0 certification must be attached Panel Type Antiglare, IPS and LED backlight technology. Energy star / BEE Star 8.0 or higher / 5 Stand Adjustment Height adjustable, Tilt and Swivel Pre loaded OEM Diagnostics Pre loaded, UEF 1 level hardware diagnostic software developed directly by the OEM, Diagnostic tool must function independently of the OS to test MB, RAM and Storage health OEM Warranty(on site) 3 years 2) Participating traders/agents/dealers/resellers/distributors have to attach valid authorized dealership cert ificate/letter from the OEM. 3) Bidders shall submit the following documents, without which the offer is liable to be rejected. (i) The following certifications of the OEM - a) Bureau of Indian standards (BIS) b) Udyam registration or factory licence or trade mark c) IS0 9001, 14001, 20001 & 27001 d) Windows / Linux certificate for the offered model/series/ marketing name e) Restriction of Hazardous Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment (RoHS) compliant for the quo ted model (not for the series). Proof to be submitted. f) Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) from CPCB. g) OEM certificate for Keyboard & Mouse from the same OEM. (ii) The bidder shall provide documentary proof for 3 years experience in the computer manufacturing for t he offered make. The contract copies along with CRAC/RITES IC/CRN shall be submitted. (iii) Service centre details in Chennai. (iv) Toll free number and escalation matrix for service support. 4) Bidders to give an undertaking to provide 3 or more years of warranty in the company letter pad, duly d ated stamped and signed, without which the offer is liable to be rejected. The bid value shall be quoted ac cordingly. 5) Compliance/offered values for the additional specification parameters shall be submitted, without which the offer is liable to be rejected.

6) Past Performance: The Bidder should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 50% of bid qu antity, in at least one of the previous Financial years(i.e. in 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) or during the cur rent financial year before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU. Copies of rel evant contracts & CRAC (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be subm itted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year. 7) Please mention correct HSN code for the offered product. 8) Product Performance: Railway reserves the right to accept/reject the offer based on past performance of the brand offered to ens ure quality/ timely honouring of warranty obligations of the offered product. 9) EMD/EPBG Details: a) If EMD & EPBG are remitted in the form of fixed deposit beneficiary name is to be mentioned as PFA/MA S for and on behalf of the president of India, Southern Railway, Park town, Chennai b) If EMD & EPBG are remitted through RTGS, it should be in the name of FA&CAO/MAS, Account no. 0129103000004374, IFSC code IBKL0000129 Bank name IDBI bank ltd, Branch address: Chennai Main Branch c) If EMD & EPBG are submitted in form Bank Guarantee beneficiary name should be PFA/MAS, For and on behalf of The President of India (i) The following line should be incorporated in the BG-" The Applicant/Seller name above has entered into the above referred contract with the Beneficiary on behalf of President of India through Dy.CMM/GSD/PER, Southern Railway Chennai 600 023 for the supply of Goods as defined in the said contract". (ii) Two independent witnesses must sign along with their names & addresses on last page of the BG. (iii) Bank Guarantee have to be duly attested by authorized signatories of bank with signature and seal on all pages. (iv) Bank guarantee number should be mentioned in all pages of BG. (v) ePBG has to be uploaded in GeM portal within 21 days from the date of release of GeM contract or else incident will be raised against the firm in GeM for non submission of ePBG. After receiving of hard copy of e PBG, GeM coverage purchase order will be released. (vi) Hard copy of ePBG has to be forwarded to Deputy Chief Materials Manager, General Stores Depot, Sou thern Railway, Chennai 600 023. (vii) If ePBG is not submitted as per the prescribed format, 5% of the contract value will be deducted from the bill. 10) Southern Railway GSTIN 33AAAGM0289C1ZQ 11) Material to be delivered at Office of the the Principal Chief Materials Manager, New Joint Office, South ern Railway, Ayanavaram, Chennai 600 023. Mob:8754470770 12) Firm must submit clause wise specification compliance letter along with the bid document otherwise of fer will be rejected. 13) OEM must have and specify the website for the download updates of software, device driver and firmw ave from the website. 14) OEM must have warranty tracking facility on portal using product serial number. 15) Operating system should be Original Microsoft Windows 11 Professional and installed by OEM as Facto ry default. The Windows Key for each system should be sticked on the product. .
